title: Grand Touring
infotainment: 34-inch Glass Cockpit + Pilot Panel; wireless CarPlay and wireless Android Auto; premium Surreal Sound Pro 21-speaker system standard.
adasStandard: DreamDrive Pro standard (full ADAS suite including hands-on highway assist, AEB, lane-keeping, blind-spot, surround view, automated parking).
adasOptional: DreamDrive 2 Premium OTA upgrade adds hands-off Highway Assist and advanced parking. Source: https://lucidmotors.com
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard high-res rear camera, dynamic guidelines, multi-angle through Glass Cockpit.
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard surround-view 360 system. No dedicated passenger-side blind-spot camera.
subscriptionFeatures: DreamDrive 2 Premium upgrade. No heated-seat or performance subscriptions.
drmNotes: Core driving works offline; connectivity-dependent for app, navigation, voice, OTA. Paid connectivity tier planned.
killSwitchNotes: No factory impaired-driving-detection kill switch as of MY2025.
knownIssues: Some Grand Touring owners report intermittent infotainment freezes (post-2024 OTA improvements), occasional door handle issues. Source: https://lucidowners.com
recalls: Shared with Air lineup; see NHTSA. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: Federal credit expired Sept 30, 2025; sedan price cap excluded Air. State programs vary; most income caps exclude Grand Touring price.

title: Pure
infotainment: 34-inch curved Glass Cockpit (instrument cluster + center display) plus lower secondary touch display ('Pilot Panel'). Native apps include Spotify, Tidal, Apple CarPlay (wireless), Android Auto (wireless added via OTA 2024). Lucid UX over Android Automotive-derived stack.
adasStandard: DreamDrive Pro (standard from 2025): adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go, lane-keeping assist, lane-departure warning, blind-spot monitoring, automatic emergency braking, cross-traffic alert, traffic-sign recognition, surround-view 360-degree camera, automatic parking assist. Driver-monitoring camera. Source: https://lucidmotors.com/air-pure
adasOptional: DreamDrive 2 Premium (subscription/upgrade) adds hands-off Highway Assist, automatic lane changes, and advanced parking assist; rolled out via OTA throughout 2025. Source: https://lucidmotors.com/stories
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard high-resolution rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines. Multi-angle views available via the 34-inch curved Glass Cockpit display. Source: https://lucidmotors.com/air
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-view 360-degree camera system standard on all 2025 Airs. Provides top-down composite view plus side cameras at low speeds. No dedicated Honda-LaneWatch-style passenger-side camera. Source: https://www.kbb.com/lucid/air/2025/specs/
subscriptionFeatures: DreamDrive 2 Premium (Highway Assist, advanced parking) is offered as an OTA-delivered upgrade. DreamConnect Premium connectivity tier announced (initially Gravity-specific; Lucid intends to expand). No subscription-gated heated seats, performance unlock, or basic features. Free Apple CarPlay/Android Auto. Source: https://lucidowners.com/threads/dreamconnect-premium.11537/
drmNotes: Core driving function works offline. Connectivity-dependent features: navigation routing (uses cached maps when offline), Lucid mobile app (remote climate/lock/charge), Tesla Supercharger payment via Lucid app, voice assistant (Lucid Assistant uses cloud), OTA updates. Lucid has stated connectivity will eventually require a subscription (DreamConnect Premium). Source: https://lucidowners.com/threads/subscription-for-enhanced-connectivity.12962/
killSwitchNotes: No factory impaired-driving-detection kill switch as of MY2025. Driver-monitoring camera tracks attention for hands-off DreamDrive use but does not disable the vehicle. Data unavailable: no Lucid public statement on the upcoming federal IIJA mandate (~2027) implementation plan.
knownIssues: Reported (lucidowners.com, CR): 12V battery drain in early production cars (fixed via OTA + service campaign), infotainment glitches (largely resolved), door handle electronics, occasional MUX/CAN faults causing warning cascades. Cabin-air-quality (HVAC) complaints early on, addressed via filter and OTA tweaks. Source: https://lucidowners.com
recalls: Several NHTSA recalls during 2022-2024 (high-voltage coolant heater, seatbelt sensor, brake hose, frunk latch). The 2025 model year so far has no recalls unique to it; carryover items addressed at production. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives:
CA CVRP retired 2023 but CA Clean Vehicle Assistance Program may apply (income-restricted). CO state credit up to $5,000 (2025). NJ no sales tax on BEVs through mid-2025. NY $2,000 Drive Clean rebate. Sources: https://afdc.energy.gov/laws/state
Note: Federal $7,500 tax credit expired Sept 30, 2025; price cap of $55,000 for sedans would have excluded Lucid Air anyway.

title: Grand Touring
infotainment: 34-inch curved Clearview Cockpit display + secondary touchscreen 'Pilot Panel'. Wireless Apple CarPlay and wireless Android Auto. Lucid Assistant voice control.
adasStandard: DreamDrive Pro standard: 30+ ADAS functions including adaptive cruise, lane-keeping, AEB, blind-spot, surround-view 360, automated parking, traffic-sign recognition, driver-monitoring camera. Source: https://lucidmotors.com/gravity
adasOptional: DreamDrive 2 Premium adds smart driving (hands-off Highway Assist) and smart parking assistance. Source: https://media.lucidmotors.com/attachment/d0010342-f57a-4ded-bab4-17f5e3f28d74
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard high-res rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines; integrated into the 34-inch Clearview Cockpit display.
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard surround-view 360-degree camera system with front, side, and rear cameras feeding a composite top-down view at low speeds.
subscriptionFeatures: DreamConnect Premium connectivity tier (Gravity first; first year typically included, then paid). DreamDrive 2 Premium hands-off Highway Assist offered as upgrade. No heated-seat or performance subscriptions. Sources: https://lucidowners.com/threads/dreamconnect-premium.11537/
drmNotes: Core driving works offline. Native NACS port (first Lucid) — direct Tesla Supercharger access at higher rates than the Air adapter solution. DreamConnect Premium (subscription connectivity tier) launched first on Gravity. Lucid app required for many remote-control features.
killSwitchNotes: No factory impaired-driving-detection kill switch. Driver-monitoring camera used only for ADAS attention tracking.
knownIssues: Inaugural model year. Early production halted briefly in early 2025 for software/QA before resuming March 2025. OTA updates pushed several feature additions and bug fixes (e.g., the major OTA covered in eletric-vehicles.com Gravity OTA story). Some early owners reported 12V issues and infotainment glitches mirroring early Air. Source: https://eletric-vehicles.com/lucid/lucid-pushes-major-ota-update-for-gravity-adding-features-fixing-issues/
recalls: Data unavailable: no MY2025 Gravity-specific recalls listed at NHTSA as of May 2026. Source checked: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives:
Federal $7,500 tax credit applied to Gravity (qualifies under SUV $80k cap when properly trimmed; Lucid offered $7,500 'Gravity Advantage Credit' continuing after federal credit's Sept 30, 2025 expiration as a manufacturer rebate). State programs: CO up to $5k, NJ no sales tax, NY $2k Drive Clean. Sources: https://www.carsdirect.com/deals-articles/lucid-gravity-advantage-credit-explained
https://evdances.com/blogs/news/lucid-extends-7-500-incentive-for-gravity-suv-buyers-despite-tax-credit-cutoff
